title: McKinney's Cotton Pickers take her out on gigs
summary: When McKinney's Cotton Pickers, including Chu Berry, visited Pittsburgh they picked up the schoolgirl and took her on jobs.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: When did you start playing at something more than parties?
Do you remember the Cotton Pickers?

Yes. When I was in around 5th or 6th grade they used to come to Pittsburgh and they'd drive this big bus on our street, all these musicians, Chu Berry and all of them would take me out on gigs with them.
Because you were that well known?
Yes. I was well known by musicians. When they'd come to Pittsburgh they'd come by and pick me up and take me out with them. I went out with the home
